title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Esther 2: young women are gathered for the king, Esther becomes queen, and Mordecai uncovers a plot.

questions.text: Into whose custody were the young virgins to be gathered in the women's house?
questions.explanation: The servants suggested gathering the virgins to the women's house, to the custody of Hegai the king's eunuch, keeper of the women.

questions.text: Mordecai, the son of Jair, is described as what?
questions.explanation: There was a certain Jew in Susa named Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite.

questions.text: What other name did Esther have?
questions.explanation: Mordecai brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther.

questions.text: How was Esther related to Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Esther was his uncle's daughter; when her father and mother died, Mordecai took her as his own daughter.

questions.text: Why had Esther not made known her people or her relatives?
questions.explanation: Esther did not make known her people or relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her not to.

answers.text: Mordecai had instructed her not to

questions.text: With what were the young women prepared during the first six months of their purification?
questions.explanation: Their purification lasted twelve months: six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances.

questions.text: What did Esther ask for when her turn came to go in to the king?
questions.explanation: She required nothing but what Hegai the king's eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised.

answers.text: A golden crown from the treasury
Her maidens to go with her

questions.text: In which month was Esther taken to King Ahasuerus?
questions.explanation: Esther was taken to the king in the tenth month, the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

questions.text: Which two eunuchs sought to lay hands on King Ahasuerus?
questions.explanation: Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king's eunuchs who were doorkeepers, were angry and sought to lay hands on the king.

questions.text: After the plotters were hanged, where was the matter written?
questions.explanation: The matter was found to be true, the two were hanged, and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king's presence.

answers.text: On the wall of the king's gate
In the book of the chronicles
In a letter to every province
In the laws of the Persians and Medes
